Text.Page:
[EN] Why would we speak of what I've seen? If you've not been there, you couldn't possibly understand, nor could I explain it.

Your time will come soon enough. Don't hasten its arrival.
[ES] ¿Por qué habríamos de hablar de lo que he visto? Si no has estado allí, podrías comprenderlo imposiblemente, ni yo podría explicarlo.

Tu momento llegará muy pronto. No apresures su llegada.
